major.label: 大调
major.scale: C D E F G A B
major.instruction: C major (Ionian); use the pentatonic subset for most melody notes.

pop.cadence: soft plagal IV to I at the loop boundary

descending.cadence: restrained authentic V to I at the loop boundary

natural_minor.label: 自然小调
natural_minor.scale: A B C D E F G
natural_minor.instruction: A natural minor (Aeolian); keep F and G natural, no raised leading tone; use the minor pentatonic subset for most melody notes.

gentle.cadence: soft minor plagal iv to i

pop.cadence: gentle modal VII to i at the loop boundary

descending.cadence: soft modal v to i at the loop boundary, without a raised leading tone

harmonic_minor.label: 和声小调
harmonic_minor.scale: A B C D E F G#
harmonic_minor.melody: A B C D E F G#
harmonic_minor.instruction: A harmonic minor; retain F natural and G# as the leading tone, resolve G# softly to A; avoid melodic leaps across F to G# and avoid dramatic diminished-chord tension.

gentle.cadence: soft minor plagal iv to i

pop.cadence: restrained authentic V to i at the loop boundary

descending.cadence: restrained authentic V to i at the loop boundary

melodic_minor.label: 旋律小调
melodic_minor.scale: ascending A B C D E F# G#; descending A G F E D C B
melodic_minor.melody: A B C D E, adding F# and G# ascending and F and G descending
melodic_minor.instruction: A classical melodic minor: ascending lines use raised sixth F# and seventh G#, descending lines use F and G natural. Harmony uses the ascending form; use A B C D E for descending lines over D major or E major, so natural F/G do not clash with F#/G# in those chords.

gentle.cadence: gentle ii to i return with common-tone voice leading

descending.cadence: restrained authentic V to i at the loop boundary
